1.name: IN+
1.hint: positive side of the shunt; common mode -0.3…26 V, differential ±26 V, with or without supply

2.name: IN-
2.hint: negative side of the shunt; the bus voltage is measured from this pin to ground

needs.source: TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 25 section 9.2: 'Use a 0.1-μF ceramic capacitor for power-supply bypassing, placed as closely as possible to the supply and ground pins'

7.name: A0
7.hint: address pin: GND, VS, SDA or SCL – four states; edakit's address model knows only low and high, so a pin tied to SDA or SCL is not computed right

8.name: A1
8.hint: address pin: GND, VS, SDA or SCL – four states; edakit's address model knows only low and high, so a pin tied to SDA or SCL is not computed right

hints: never more than 26 V on the device (7.5 note 2); IN+ and IN– withstand 0–26 V whether VS is applied or not
Kelvin (4-wire) connection of IN+ and IN– to the shunt (11.1)
I2C fast mode to 400 kHz, high-speed mode to 2.56 MHz; SMBus timeout resets the interface after 28–35 ms low
address pins A0/A1: GND, VS, SDA or SCL give 16 addresses 0x40–0x4F (Table 1); edakit computes only GND/VS
sources: pin numbers and names: EasyEDA library data of C87469 (edakit part import, 2026-10-31); checked against TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 3 Pin Functions (DCN SOT-23 column)

TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 4 7.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings: VS 6 V; IN+/IN– differential ±26 V, common mode -0.3…26 V; SDA GND - 0.3…6 V; SCL GND - 0.3 V…VS + 0.3 V (vin_rel_max_v – A0/A1 have no row of their own); input current into any pin 5 mA; open-drain digital output current 10 mA (i_out_max_a); TJ 150 °C

TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 4 7.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: VCM nom 12 V, VS nom 3.3 V, TA -25…85 °C (t_min_c, t_max_c); 7.4 Thermal Information: RθJA 135.4 °C/W (DCN), 111.3 °C/W (D)

TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 5 7.5: IN– input bias 20 µA || 320 kΩ (z_in_ohm, typical); digital inputs VIH 0.7 × VS … 6 V, VIL -0.3 V … 0.3 × VS

TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 6 7.5 continued: SDA VOL max 0.4 V at 3 mA; operating supply range 3–5.5 V; quiescent current max 1 mA (idd_max_a); 7.6: fSCL 0.001–0.4 MHz fast mode, 0.001–2.56 MHz high-speed mode

TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 14 Table 1: slave address 1000000 (A1 = A0 = GND) … A0 = VS +1, A1 = VS +4; SDA/SCL states give the rest
TI INA219 Zerø-Drift, Bidirectional Current/Power Monitor With I2C Interface, SBOS448G (August 2008, revised December 2015), p. 25 9.2 and p. 27 section 10: 0.1 µF ceramic bypass at VS

checked: pinout and pin names = datasheet Pin Functions, SOT-23 (DCN) column = EasyEDA symbol
abs. max VS 6 V, IN± 26 V, SDA 6 V, SCL VS + 0.3 V, TJ 150 °C; RθJA 135.4 °C/W (DCN)
VS 3–5.5 V; VIH 0.7 × VS, VIL 0.3 × VS; quiescent current max 1 mA
I2C address 0x40 + A0 (1) + A1 (4) for GND/VS
